headline: Two of the three things keeping the factory frozen are dead; the third is a real bug, and it has a name
lede: Main's nightly was red on two families. Both fixes landed — a title's NaN can no longer kill a page, and the papersplay ink gates now grade the frame the browser actually painted. The rerun came back 902/903 with something better than flake: a reproducible stall in a game, filed with the causes already ruled out.

notes.text: The two original red families are closed: audio-NaN guard (#2166, `b13c6f2`) and CI-calibrated papersplay ink sampling (#2170, `f4c9f25`). In the proving nightly the audio pageerrors are gone and papersplay reads 144/144; slot a's duplicate fix #2169 was closed as superseded so the tag floor can't move twice.

What's left is one gate and it looks real: fire-crew's crew takes the WATCH seat and then does not move or rescue for the whole 42 s resume window — reproducible deterministically at `watchcheck --only fire-crew --throttle 32`, green at throttle 8. The shift clock (tick 7200) was nowhere near expiring at tick ~800, so this is not a finished run wearing a flake costume. Filed as #2178 with the ruled-out trail; four green PRs wait on it.

PLAICRAFT S1 stage one (#2155, PR #2175): iPhone Safari portrait keeps ~110px of chrome, so the 100vh shell pushed the entire stick band (y 746-836 at 390x844) past the fold, and #2092's scroll lock meant nothing could pan up to it. One `--shell-h` token (100vh fallback, 100dvh visible) now drives the document, the game shell, four games and all 14 demo pages, guarded by a new browser-free gate `dvhcheck` that reddens any shell sizing to the tall viewport.

`git checkout -- <file>` in a lane worktree restores HEAD, which is origin/main — on a branch with uncommitted work it deletes your fix, not the mutation. Commit first, then mutate. Related: `git add -A` happily commits your throwaway probe file too.
